posts.hook: Zuckerberg just told the AI industry: evaluate, don't slow down.
posts.caption: zuckerberg says ai labs should train safely, not slow down, as sanders and bannon share a stage demanding tighter ai rules and cybersecurity experts call the industry's apocalypse warnings incoherent. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Zuckerberg picks evaluators over an AI slowdown
slides.desc: Says every lab has "responsibility and incentive" to train safely; Meta delayed Muse for it.

slides.title: OpenAI in early talks on a $1.2T pre-IPO round
slides.desc: Same week OpenRouter spend flipped to OpenAI over Anthropic for the first time since 2024.

slides.title: Sanders and Bannon share a stage to demand AI limits
slides.desc: Cross-partisan assembly in DC, the same week a poll found 61% oppose AI data centers.

slides.title: Experts call AI leaders' hacking warnings incoherent
slides.desc: Cybersecurity pros tell NBC the apocalyptic framing misreads the actual technical risk.

slides.title: Researchers took over Baseten's production GitHub
slides.desc: A leaked access token gave admin access to the AI infra company's org, disclosed publicly.

slides.title: Perplexity dumped DynamoDB for its own CobbleDB
slides.desc: Two engineers built it with coding agents; storage latency down 82%, cost down 20%.

posts.hook: AI's safety unity just cracked from the inside.
posts.caption: ai's safety unity cracked today: deepmind's shane legg and microsoft's mustafa suleyman broke ranks to challenge anthropic and openai, as staff at both labs say they felt blindsided by their own ceos' slowdown pledges. cohere and aleph alpha merged into a $20b rival and openai's valuation talk jumped to $1.5 trillion. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Staff say they were blindsided by their own CEOs
slides.desc: OpenAI and Anthropic employees tell the FT they weren't briefed on the slowdown pledges.

slides.title: Suleyman: training Claude to "imitate consciousness" is a mistake
slides.desc: Microsoft's AI chief says it could make Anthropic's models harder to control.

slides.title: Cohere and Aleph Alpha merge into a $20B OpenAI rival
slides.desc: Canada's Cohere and Germany's Aleph Alpha combine under the Cohere name.

slides.title: OpenAI's ask jumps from $1.2T to $1.5T
slides.desc: Investors offered $1.2T; OpenAI says it's worth more, days after delaying its IPO.

slides.title: Anthropic merges Cowork into Claude, adds Docs and Slides
slides.desc: One chat interface now covers documents and presentations, echoing Workspace and Office.

slides.title: PS5 Linux's lead quits over LLM-written contributions
slides.desc: Cites contributors who submit code from LLMs they don't understand.
